about.title: About Us
about.p1: At BerryBit Studios, we believe that cozy games can tell powerful stories. We're a passionate team of developers, artists, and storytellers on a mission to blend emotional depth with magical worlds — and maybe break a few hearts along the way.
about.p2: Born from late-night game jams, scribbled notebooks, and a friendship that turned into creative fire — BerryBit grew into more than just a studio. It became a home for heartfelt ideas.
about.p3: Our philosophy is simple: games can be soft, gentle, and still unforgettable. We embrace slowness, silence, and wonder — the kind of storytelling that lingers.
about.p4: We value emotion-driven design, thoughtful mechanics, and visual worlds you want to stay in. BerryBit isn't just about pixels — it's about people.
